item.title: Tough New AT-AT-Like Enemy in Helldivers 2
item.description: Helldivers 2 bumps the level cap to 150, adds blizzards and sandstorms, and stealthily deploys the “Factory Strider”—a massive, heavily armed Automaton walking fortress that spawns Devastators.
